schema_note: UAS-native taxonomy. Technique IDs are domain-specific (UAS-<DOMAIN>-NNN). Enterprise ATT&CK analogs are listed as informational cross-references only — they are NOT claimed as exact mappings, which was the prior error.

tactics.name: Reconnaissance
tactics.summary: Locate and fingerprint the airframe, links, and operator.

tactics.name: Initial Access
tactics.summary: Reach a control or service surface on the airframe.

tactics.name: Link Manipulation
tactics.summary: Degrade, inject into, or hijack the RF/control link.

tactics.name: Onboard Compromise
tactics.summary: Execute and persist on flight controller / payload.

tactics.name: Impact
tactics.summary: Capture, crash, exfiltrate, or deny the mission.

techniques.name: Wi-Fi Key Recovery / Deauth
techniques.summary: Recover a weak link key or deauthenticate the operator to take over the control Wi-Fi.
techniques.enterpriseAnalog: informational: T1557 (AiTM) — not an exact map

techniques.name: MAVLink Injection / Replay
techniques.summary: Inject or replay unsigned MAVLink to issue commands or alter telemetry.

techniques.name: Remote ID Spoofing / DoS
techniques.summary: Spoof or deny Open Drone ID / Remote ID broadcasts.

techniques.name: GNSS Spoofing
techniques.summary: Transmit counterfeit GNSS signals to mislead position.
techniques.enterpriseAnalog: informational: no clean enterprise analog — UAS-specific

techniques.name: GNSS Jamming
techniques.summary: Overpower GNSS to force failsafe/return-to-home or drift.

techniques.name: IMU / Sensor Manipulation
techniques.summary: Acoustic or EM interference with inertial sensors to destabilize flight.
techniques.enterpriseAnalog: informational: no clean enterprise analog — UAS-specific

techniques.name: Onboard Service Disclosure
techniques.summary: Enumerate FTP/HTTP/RTSP/debug services on the airframe AP.

techniques.name: Unauthenticated Service Access
techniques.summary: Reach an exposed Telnet/SSH/debug service with no authentication.

techniques.name: Onboard Denial of Service
techniques.summary: Crash or hang onboard services to disrupt the mission.

techniques.name: Firmware Extraction
techniques.summary: Dump firmware via debug header or update package for analysis.

techniques.name: Control-Protocol Memory Corruption
techniques.summary: Trigger memory corruption via malformed control-protocol messages (e.g. DUML).

techniques.name: Firmware Downgrade
techniques.summary: Install an older signed build to re-enable a patched flaw.

techniques.name: Debug-Port Access
techniques.summary: Use accessible JTAG/SWD/UART headers for code execution or key extraction.
